page.layout: One scanned page, a cover or flyleaf with no printed text. Only library labels, a handwritten inscription and stains.
page.notes: No printed text on this scan. The yellow label at top left (6 / 3-e / 44) and the star-shaped label at left (6 / 1 C / 20) are library shelf marks and were left out. The handwritten inscription in the centre-right (partly legible, something like "...magnus erit" and "Ramus est magnus") is manuscript, not print, and was left out. Dark stains, ink smudges and a blue cloth label at the bottom are not transcribed.
